verdict.rationale: The Amazon Chime SDK is a real-time audio, video and messaging SDK, so routing a live session into a voice-agent pipeline is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents only media modalities, codecs, data messages, PSTN dial-in and SIP media applications. Nothing describes speech-to-text, a model, or text-to-speech integration, and the SIP and PSTN telephony features are adjacent rather than a documented voice-agent path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the vendor documents an integration path from a live session to a voice-agent pipeline of speech-to-text, a model, and text-to-speech
